Thank you @POTUS for your commitment to reducing cancer deaths & improving the lives of people living with cancer.

I consider myself fortunate to have access to care for my own cancer. We must do more to ensure prevention, diagnosis, and treatment is in reach for everyone.

In the United States of America, a cancer diagnosis should not leave you in bankruptcy

Across race, gender, region, and socioeconomic status we must do more to ensure prevention, diagnosis, and treatment is in reach for everyone

#WorldCancerDay

It's been 80 year since the unjust & unconstitutional internment of Japanese people in this country
 
The horrific treatment of Japanese people—simply because of their ancestry—is a stain on our country's history https://t.co/MacFbiYTY8

At the start of the pandemic, amid school closures & widespread layoffs, Congress created child nutrition waivers to keep children fed.

Now the waivers are at risk of expiring, which is why I led the Hawaii delegation in urging @USDA to extend them & keep kids from going hungry. https://t.co/gbGFqLwgzl

Senate Republicans just voted to block much-needed legislation to fund COVID testing, treatment, and vaccines.

Where have they been the past two years?

Just like health care, food for children should be a right, not a privilege.
 
That's why I'm fighting to extend the flexibilities schools need to keep kids fed.
https://t.co/EcYrbIaqxk

Mahalo to Kalihi Kai Elementary for welcoming me today to see firsthand how Hawaii schools are using child nutrition flexibilities to keep kids fed.

I'm fighting to extend these flexibilities to help ensure no child goes hungry. https://t.co/d6YXaJqspd

Republicans are once again trying to undermine the #TitleX program, which helps patients access essential health care like:

💊Birth control
🩺STI testing and treatment
🥼Cancer detection screenings

Today, I'm voting to block this attack on our health care and our bodies. https://t.co/boH8EvZswM

In 2019, AANHPIs had the lowest rate of mental health treatment of any racial or ethnic population.

As we mark AANHPI #MentalHealthDay, I'm working to break down barriers that prevent too many members of our community from receiving the care they need and deserve.

Wishing @POTUS a full and swift recovery.
 
I'm glad to hear that, thanks to the vaccine and boosters, his symptoms are mild. If you haven't already, now is the time to get vaccinated or boosted.

This week, I visited @maoorganicfarms, a local farm in West Oahu that promotes nutrition and sustainability in every aspect of their operations. I secured nearly $900,000 to help them expand their business and further advance Hawaii's local-grown sustainable food system. https://t.co/gXnGiBkMBo

As we continue to monitor the results of this midterm cycle, I'd like to thank all of the election workers across the country for their invaluable work.

Election workers are on the frontlines of our democracy and their work ensures we can all exercise our right to vote.

My thoughts are with my friend @SenBobCasey and his family today.
 
A cancer diagnosis is always serious, but I'm encouraged to hear that his prognosis is excellent.
 
I wish him a speedy and complete recovery.

Women in need of mifepristone for early-pregnancy miscarriages are experiencing barriers to this effective and safe treatment.
 
Updating mifepristone’s label will make this drug accessible for miscarriage management by providing clear guidance for health care providers.

People experiencing miscarriage deserve access to safe and effective treatment, without added and unnecessary pain.
 
I'll continue doing everything I can to make sure reproductive health care treatments are available to anyone who needs them.

This year, Congress needs to pass the Farm Bill again.
 
I look forward to working with Chair Stabenow and our colleagues to make sure this important legislation benefits Hawaii, our specialty crops, nutrition, and helps combat hunger—and gets signed into law.

From Honolulu to Hollywood, and all across our country, creative professionals are coming together to demand fair compensation and treatment.

I stand with the @sagaftra & WGA members as they strike for the dignified working conditions they deserve.

We are seeing a resurgence of labor organizing across our country to demand fair pay, decent treatment, and basic dignity.

At a time like this, we need a @USDOL Secretary who can bring labor and management together.

Julie Su is that person. https://t.co/2tsoDS5SDE

Like many of us in the room, @POTUS bowed his head in a deeply emotional moment.

For right wing trolls, let alone sitting members of Congress, to politicize Maui’s pain with blatant lies is cowardly and vile.
https://t.co/oAuh5IPv3p

Too often, our veterans do not receive the care they need and are owed—especially women veterans who face additional barriers compared to their male counterparts.

From mental health to financial wellness and access to care, the government must do better.  https://t.co/3xKr5E0HFE

Voting is essential to our democracy—but far too many people are unable to exercise their right to vote because they can't get time off from work.

I just led 11 of my colleagues on a bill that would ensure workers nationwide have paid time off to vote in federal elections.

Here's what @SenateDems' Right to IVF Act does:

✅Establish a nationwide right to access IVF
✅Ensure doctors can provide IVF treatment
✅Increase IVF affordability
✅ Protect and expand fertility treatments for servicemembers and veterans

It's really that simple.

Today, we're voting on @SenDuckworth, @PattyMurray, and @SenBooker's bill to codify access to and coverage of IVF treatment into law.

If Republican claims of supporting IVF are true, we shouldn't have a problem passing this bill. But don't hold your breath.

As we celebrate and honor working people this Labor Day, thousands of hotel workers in Hawaii and across the country are on strike for better wages and fair treatment. 

During the COVID crisis, cutbacks to hotel staffing and services forced workers to do more with less—cutbacks that have yet to be restored. While hotel profits are high, workers aren’t seeing the benefits they deserve. 

I'm proud to join @uniteherehawaii workers on the picket line in Waikiki and I urge hotel management to come to an agreement with striking workers in Hawaii and around the country.

Funding for @988Lifeline, mental health programs, substance use prevention education, addiction treatment research—all functions of @samhsagov threatened by RFK Jr.’s reckless HHS firings.

In the midst of a mental health and drug overdose crisis, these cuts will hurt millions.
